en.headline: ICAC charges former crypto shop staff over diverted USDT trades
en.dek: A former Sheung Shui shop assistant is accused of taking bribes to shift customer Tether deals into other wallets, totalling nearly HK$9 million.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption said on Wednesday that it had charged a former staff member of a cryptocurrency exchange shop with conspiracy for an agent to accept advantages, alleging he diverted customer trades into wallets controlled by others.

According to the ICAC, the 31-year-old defendant worked as a customer service and operations assistant at the Sheung Shui branch of a firm that runs several cash-for-crypto shops in Hong Kong. Staff were required to complete customer deals through the company's own wallets.

Prosecutors allege that between August and November 2023 he accepted payments from two men and routed customers' Tether (USDT) purchases and sales through wallets those men supplied. The commission said he was to receive HK$200 for each day on which he arranged such trades.

Investigators said the diverted cash-for-crypto deals over those three months involved more than 1.1 million USDT, worth nearly HK$9 million. The defendant has been released on bail and is due to appear at Fanling Magistrates' Courts on Friday. He is presumed innocent unless and until a court finds otherwise.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴加密幣找換店前職員涉收賄轉移交易
zh.dek: 指上水分店前職員暗中將客戶泰達幣買賣轉至他人錢包，三個月交易額近九百萬元，周五粉嶺裁判法院答辯。
body: 廉政公署星期三落案起訴一名加密貨幣找換店前職員，控他涉嫌串謀使代理人接受利益，暗中將客戶交易轉移至他人提供的加密貨幣錢包。
廉署指，31歲被告曾任一間在港經營多間找換店公司的客戶服務及營運助理，派駐上水分店，負責與客戶交易，交易須經公司錢包完成。
控罪指，被告涉嫌於2023年8月至11月向兩名男子收受賄款，並使用他們提供的錢包與客戶進行泰達幣（USDT）買賣。廉署指，他每措成交易的日子可獲酬勞200元。
調查指，他在三個月內涉嫌私下與客戶完成的現金買賣逾110萬枚泰達幣，折合接近九百萬港元。被告獲准保釋，定於星期五在粉嶺裁判法院答辯，在法庭判定前推定無罪。
